Next.js 15.5.4 TypeScript strict App Router luxury site; Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind 3.4.17, Radix/shadcn New York RSC, Geist, Lucide, Vercel Analytics, Vitest, Playwright. Auto-synced v0.app→GitHub→Vercel.

Routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`; APIs: `contact/` POST Resend, `chatkit/session/` POST OpenAI, `intake/` POST Supabase. See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md). Architecture: [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json).

Structure: `app/`, `components/`, `lib/`, `public/`, `styles/`, `tests/`; `globals.css`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`; reusable StickyHeader, Footer, GlassCard, FrostedButton, PageTitle, Section, JSON-LD, Calendly, analytics/A-B/theme providers. Mobile-first glassmorphism, dark/light OKLCH tokens, iOS viewport fixes, accessibility, SEO metadata/JSON-LD.

`.env.local` (see `.env.local.example`): `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

Commands:
pnpm dev
pnpm serve
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm ci:verify
pnpm report:types
pnpm scan:secrets
pnpm scan:secrets:staged
pnpm test
pnpm test:watch
pnpm test:jest
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --ui
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts
pnpm lh:routes

Vitest uses `tests/setup.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`, `@/`, jsdom, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, excludes Playwright, `passWithNoTests: false`. Playwright tests mobile layout, screenshots in `tests/screenshots/`; default configuration. ESLint errors and TypeScript build errors ignored for deployment compatibility.

JWT uses `jose`, `JWT_SECRET`, client passcodes; `/clients/[client]` requires valid JWT. Never expose secrets. Feature branches/PRs required; direct pushes to main blocked. Pre-commit scans staged secrets; pre-push scans all secrets. Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Consider v0.app sync implications for manual edits.
